subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should Codex app-server connection establishment share appServer.requestTimeoutMs, or use a distinct internal connection deadline?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents indefinite waits, but extending the operator's RPC timeout to startup handshakes changes fail-closed and compatibility semantics; upstream Codex also treats connection timing separately.

options.title: Reuse requestTimeoutMs
options.body: Use the existing operator-owned app-server budget for connection establishment and RPCs, avoiding another config surface while bounding all waits.

options.title: Use an internal connect deadline
options.body: Match upstream Codex's separate connection-timeout model with a fixed internal deadline while leaving requestTimeoutMs scoped to RPC operations.

recommendation.title: Reuse requestTimeoutMs
recommendation.body: Use the existing operator-owned app-server budget for connection establishment and RPCs, avoiding another config surface while bounding all waits.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history ties this person to the Codex extension harness and app-server ownership boundary where the timeout contract lives.
